stations.name: What it covers
stations.meaning: Which hazard, which asset, which parts; what is left out
stations.paragraph: Hurricane wind on batteries: solar TC-wind ordered damage-state curves reused as a T4 (our judgment) hypothesis, with BESS enclosure state costs from a related NREL cost split and full replacement at major damage. It names 2 parts: Integrated battery enclosure and Separate PCS. Outside its scope: storm surge and rain flooding (Flood cell), convective wind and tornado (separate scope), autonomous internal failures, collector station and export line and business interruption. Kinds of damage it does not include: windborne debris, wind-driven rain ingress and triggered propagation between units.

stations.name: What breaks
stations.meaning: The parts of the plant the hazard damages, each with its own curve
stations.paragraph: For this hazard the battery plant is split into 2 parts: Integrated battery enclosure and Separate PCS. 3 further units are named but withheld — bess mv and shared electrical, bess civil and bess fieldwork — a stated 'not zero', not a curve. Parts of the plant's value with no curve yet: unit MV and shared electrical, civil works and fieldwork.

stations.name: How damage is measured
stations.meaning: The hazard intensity on the x-axis and the shape of the curve
stations.paragraph: Damage is read against pressure ratio, (event 3-s gust ÷ declared reference 3-s gust)². The curve is ordered damage states, each reached with a lognormal chance as demand rises. The input, in the catalogue's words: pressure ratio: (event 3-second gust / declared reference gust) squared, dimensionless, valid 0 to 2; outside the range is withheld, not clamped.

stations.name: Where the numbers come from
stations.meaning: The sources, what was taken from each, and how sure we are
stations.paragraph: 13 sources set this cell: Hazard BESS r1 selected profile and budget, Solar TC-wind model v2.1 docs r2, SMA MVPS-S2-SCS-US system manual, storm mounting and anchorage and Tesla Industrial Lithium-Ion Battery Emergency Response Guide rev 2.8 and 9 more. Of the 9 parameters, 1 is transferred (T3) and 8 are our judgment (T4). The source and claim registers are machine-readable files in the cell folder.

stations.name: What it is worth
stations.meaning: The share of the plant's value the curves cover
stations.paragraph: $94.4M of $109.8M of the reference plant has a curve (86 %). No curve yet for unit MV and shared electrical, civil works and fieldwork (14 % of the value).

stations.name: The audit
stations.meaning: The seven checks a curve passes before release
stations.paragraph: No seven-step audit was found as a file or as a section of the dossier. That is a finding, not an omission of the page. A site-condition adapter has not been written for this cell.

stations.name: The files
stations.meaning: The runtime file, the write-up and the workbook
stations.paragraph: The runtime file is the curve artifact with 3 curve records (model v1.0, docs r1). The write-up is derivation.md. The cell folder holds 14 files, each with its SHA under Details.

stations.name: What it can output
stations.meaning: What a consumer may compute with this curve
stations.paragraph: One hurricane wind event, a dollar scenario, yearly loss and PML, VaR and TVaR are available only under conditions the consumer (Hazard) checks. Annual metrics belong to the consumer; nothing here is an expected annual loss.

stations.name: How it was tested
stations.meaning: The known answers this build reproduced
stations.paragraph: This build reproduced 20 of 20 known answers through the cell's evaluator (within 1e-12 on the damage ratio). The validation record says passed conditional annual screening. No outside check has been made yet.

stations.name: Seen in the field, and reviewed
stations.meaning: Field reports of this damage, and who has read the entry
stations.paragraph: Not searched — nobody has looked for field reports yet. The catalogue entry has been read by an agent only (2026-10-19); no person has reviewed it yet. The curve release carries its own review state: same author with independent numerical methods.
